home_prompt: Use case ui-mockup. Create an original polished Japanese website homepage proposal for 「RCスペースみちおか」, radio control and plastic model shop in Akita. Single 16:9 landscape. Prominent top-left badge 「非公式デザイン案」, clear bottom-right 「写真はイメージです」. Original clean white/dark graphite with restrained cobalt accent; no existing logo copied. Large desktop homepage left 65%; large straight-on mobile screen right 30%. Original unbranded imagined hobby RC touring model car on simple workbench hero, not actual stock/shop/circuit. Headline 「つくる、走らせる、楽しむ。」 and 「ラジコン・模型の店」. Categories 「ラジコン」「プラモデル」「ミニ四駆」. Button 「店舗・お問い合わせ」. Focus responsive shop/contact facts. Show these same facts desktop lower area and mobile LARGE legible stacked cards with each label ABOVE value, safely inside screen, full addresses and Friday hours all visible with wrapping: 「店舗・お問い合わせ」; 「住所」 「秋田県秋田市大住2丁目17-22」; 「TEL / FAX」 「018-835-4055」; 「営業時間」 「10:30〜19:30」 new line 「金曜日 15:00〜19:30」; 「定休日」 「年中無休」; 「メール」 「modeo@cf6.so-net.ne.jp」. Button 「メールで問い合わせる」 below. Entire mobile facts within phone, no horizontal overflow, crisp correct text. NO inquiry form, no booking, no invented live chat, no false stock/prices/guarantees, no track because official miniaturetrack closed. General website consumer text only. No copying photos/logos/competitor layout. Show warm hobby feel.
inquiry_prompt: Use case ui-mockup. New separate original 16:9 matching 「店舗・お問い合わせ」 page proposal for RCスペースみちおか. Reference image STYLE ONLY; same white graphite cobalt palette. PROMINENT top-left blue badge 「非公式デザイン案」 and bottom-right readable blue badge 「写真はイメージです」, must include both. Desktop page left 60%, extra-large straight-on mobile screen right 35%. Focus on READABLE SHOP INFORMATION, reduce hero photo to small original unbranded RC hobby car accent. Store name EXACT 「RCスペースみちおか」, title 「店舗・お問い合わせ」. Desktop facts and mobile facts must all be visible with no sideways cutoffs; single vertical column with labels ABOVE values, full address wrapping at natural breaks. Exact text: 「住所」 then 「〒010-1436」 and 「秋田県秋田市大住2丁目17-22」; 「TEL / FAX」 then 「018-835-4055」; 「営業時間」 then 「10:30〜19:30」 and separate line 「金曜日 15:00〜19:30」; 「定休日」 then 「年中無休」; 「メール」 then 「modeo@cf6.so-net.ne.jp」 with enough width and correctly spelled. Blue button 「メールで問い合わせる」. Every information block fully INSIDE phone screen, large readable Japanese, empty negative space around margins. This is existing phone and email contact policy; NO FORM, no booking, no extra fields, no fake sent state, no invented response-time or appointment policy. No map with guessed locations, no claimed active circuit, no prices or guarantee. NO copied logo, product marks, photos or text from competitors. Main improvement is wrapping address/hours in phone width.
